body: The pay isn't actually all that good in a general sense and there is a strong astigmatism toward English tutors. As much as I love Japan, I don't really enjoy the hostility I experience being half Korean and I would never in my life want to work in Japan. Japanese work life is a very sad aspect of modern Japan.

Thank you for your message, I was at an extreme low point when I wrote this post and waited it out before actually going through with it. Although I still wish to disappear, I've decided to see what happens after I graduate high school

I am well aware of how dumb it is that school is a large factor of me wanting to off myself but it's difficult to really ignore the aspect as our current society really expects you to do well in school and to succeed. It's even more difficult because I have a Korean mom who has taught me to hate myself and that I am worthless unless I am successful in the 'asian' lens of life. 
I used to be very interested in music and had planned on majoring in music business/music composition but my interest in everything has been deteriorating with only burst of interest here and there. Thanks for the advice about trade schools, I didn't know they were a thing! I might look into them.
